TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT APPLICATION
PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS

2821 NORTH MELVINA AVENUE
AND
6148 WEST DIVERSEY AVENUE

2821 N. Melvina Avenue: RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to C2-
1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District

and

6148 W. Diversey Avenue: B3-1 Community Shopping District to C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related
Commercial District

The Applicant seeks to rezone the Subject Property from RT-4 and B3-1 to C2-1 in order to allow
for the business activities of motor vehicle repair shop and outdoor light equipment sale / rental to
be permitted.

The existing one-story 5,326 square foot commercial structure will remain. There will be seven
(7) off-street parking spaces. No changes will be made to the bulk, height or exterior structure of
the building other than cosmetic and maintenance improvements. No residential dwelling units
are being proposed.
